# U183: Verifying and the picker: as Amara, CI pipeline time’s page offers Verify this metric; the form shows the difference from the stored figure in minutes, and Mark as Verified makes it Verified with her record; Couldn’t reproduce on Time to first review keeps it Defined and shows her attempt in an outlined box; a goal measured by Remote build cache hit rate warns that it is measured by a Draft metric, with what’s missing; Measured by lists Defined metrics before Draft ones, each with its window and refresh

- **Belongs to:** the Metric library module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `METRIC-VERIFY`, `METRIC-STAGE`, `METRICS-MEASURED-BY`
- **Budget:** at most 12 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/metrics/ci-time` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U183

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/metrics/ci-time` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Verify this metric” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Verify this metric” link.
- **Check:** The “Verify CI pipeline time” heading shows.
- Tick the “I opened the link and it shows this metric, for this window” field.
- **Step.** Type “21” into the “The figure you got from the link” field.
- **Check:** “Your 21 min” is shown in the “Difference” part (`[data-part="Difference"]`) (else: the form does not show the figure against the stored one).
- **Step.** Type “Matches within rounding.” into the “Note” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Mark as Verified” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “Verified” is shown in the metric top (`.metric-top`) (else: CI pipeline time is not Verified after Mark as Verified).
- **Check:** “Verified by Amara Nwosu” is shown in the “Verification” part (`[data-part="Verification"]`) (else: the verification record does not name Amara).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “verified”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- Go to `/metrics/first-review/verify` in the demo.
- Tick the “I opened the link and it shows this metric, for this window” field.
- **Step.** Type “9” into the “The figure you got from the link” field.
- **Step.** Type “The dashboard counts bot reviews; the definition doesn’t say.” into the “Note” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Couldn’t reproduce” button.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** “Couldn’t reproduce · Amara Nwosu” is shown in the “Couldn't reproduce” part (`[data-part="Couldn't reproduce"]`) (else: the failed attempt is not on the page).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `new Set(outline).size === 1 && outline[0] !== '0px'`, where `const box = p.locator('[data-part="Couldn\'t reproduce"]')`; `const outline = await box.evaluate((e) => { const c = getComputedStyle(e); return [c.borderTopWidth, c.borderRightWidth, c.borderBottomWidth, c.borderLeftWidth]; })`. Else it says: the attempt box is not a full outline ({outline.join(' ')}).
- **Check:** “Defined” is shown in the metric top (`.metric-top`) (else: a failed attempt changed the stage).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “attempt”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A goal on a Draft metric (sketch 7): it keeps working and warns, with the warning mark, never a status shape.
- Go to `/metrics/cache-hit` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “See its goal” link.
- **Step.** Press the link in the main (`main a`).
- **Check:** “Measured by a Draft metric” is shown in the “Draft metric” part (`[data-part="Draft metric"]`) (else: the goal does not warn that its metric is Draft).
- **Check:** (`progress`) the svg (`svg[data-status]`) in the “Draft metric” part (`[data-part="Draft metric"]`) is not there and there are 1 of the “See what’s missing” link in the “Draft metric” part (`[data-part="Draft metric"]`) (else: the warning uses a status shape, or has no See what’s missing).
- _Note:_ Measured by (sketch 7): Defined and Verified first, each with its window and refresh.
- Go to `/goals/{gid}/edit` in the demo.
- Press the “Measured by” button.
- Type “pipeline” into a search field in the open find-and-pick list.
- **Check:** An option in the open find-and-pick list shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `named.length >= 2 && (firstDraft === -1 || firstDraft > lastDefined) && named.every((o) => /Refreshed \w+/.test(o) && /(Rolling|Per |Point|Cumulative|Not said)/.test(o))`, where `const panel = p.locator('.pick.open')`; `const opts = await panel.getByRole('option').evaluateAll((os) => os.map((o) => o.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')))`; `const named = opts.filter((o) => /pipeline/i.test(o))`; `const firstDraft = named.findIndex((o) => /\bDraft\b/.test(o))`; `const lastDefined = named.map((o) => /\b(Defined|Verified)\b/.test(o)).lastIndexOf(true)`. Else it says: Measured by lists: {named.join(' | ')}.
- **Check:** (`errors`) scored as met here.
- **Check:** (`logged`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
